以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
Two separate traps, both silent. (1) ids_capture_diff.py segments graphs at `ffn_moe_gate-1`, an ids row: had the dst rows been printed after all ids rows, every dst row would land in one final pseudo-graph, get compared against nothing, and be reported as IDENTICAL -- a false negative in the one direction this instrument exists to rule out. Solved with a shared submission sequence number and a merge in the dump. (2) The ids operand is produced MANY nodes upstream of mul_mat_id and has long settled; the dst is produced by the IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING kernel. That asymmetry is the diagnostic signature in the control: ids reproducible, dst not. It points straight at ordering, not at values.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
no barrier: ids 120 SAME / dst DIFF every graph, same arm. With barrier: both SAME. The asymmetry was the tell that identified the mechanism.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.cpp`, `scripts/check/ids_capture_diff.py`

A second capture stream that must be paired with an existing one has to be emitted in SUBMISSION order across both streams, not appended after the first. And when a capture is placed after a kernel whose output it reads, it needs an explicit memory barrier if the fork allows kernel concurrency.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
The first version of the post-sync readback ('CGC-S1: POST') also read the gather's INDEX vector to recompute table[idx] == gather. That vector is the CONT output feeding the gather and is not an output, so by the time the graph had completed its buffer had been handed to another tensor: layer 1 read small ints, layers 2 and 3 read F32 bit patterns (idx=1043923934), and the probe reported 16/16 mismatches that were entirely its own artifact. This is the exact mirror of the encode-time race recorded in eng-diag-0015 - one probe read a buffer before it was written, this one read a dead buffer after. The correct comparison pins the value or samples it at the right moment, which is what the hook-side EXPECT lines already do.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.cpp`

A transient tensor's buffer cannot be read after the graph completes: ggml-alloc recycles it as soon as its last consumer has run, so such a read returns a different tensor's data. Pin it, or sample it while it is still live.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
逐層表是**桶**不是層：`decode_step_profile.py:279` 是 `last = {l["layer"]: l for l in layers}`（last-wins）⇒ 表描述的是最後一個 step；而多數表還把第 1 個 step（暖池、`cb` 大三倍）一起平均。兩者都會把一個只在特定形狀出現的效應報成「這一層很重」。同一個 bucket 的歸屬也不直觀：`ggml-backend.cpp:2013-2036` 的逐層索引取自 topk 名字 →（無 topk）split 最後一個節點名字 →（皆無）split 序號，而 `:2017` 的 `callback_eval` 回 false 的 segment 不進任何桶。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
2026-09-18 L0：先前的表把「L0 gpu 17.88 / union 9.25 ms 對中位 2.47 / 1.77」報成一個可用 `CGC_S1_MIN_IL=0` 換掉的 +10%（而且說「不改數值」）。改用 47 個 steady steps 的逐層中位數後，**異常本身在 `ntok=1` 形狀下確認**（7.2×／5.2×，佔 GPU busy 的 15.3%，且 L0 的 host 側欄位完全正常 ⇒ 超額在 GPU 側）；但同一支分析器在**要優化的投機形狀**（`ntok=2/4`）下沒有重現（L0 10.62／5.74，不在 top6）。而槓桿本身不可達：`CGC_S1_MIN_IL` 只在 `CGC_SLOT_TABLE_GPU` 存在時被讀（`run_server.sh:1518` 生產不傳），且 L0 是結構上的永久排除項（`decode_sweep.py:410-412`：其 MoE 跑 CPU/BLAS，跨 backend 複製就是 20:18 SIGSEGV 的形狀）。

它管轄的檔案：`docs/L0_ATTRIBUTION_2026-09-18.md`, `scripts/check/decode_sweep.py`
**一個逐層數字要在「聚合方式」與「量測形狀」兩者都指名之後才可以引用。** 判別式是「換一個聚合會不會消失」——用逐層 × steady steps 的中位數重算；若異常只在某一種 `ntok` 形狀下存在，它就是形狀相依的，不可以在另一個形狀上拿它當優化目標。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
單發吞吐量的散佈在共用機器上可以到 40%（同一個 A11 指紋的兩臂可差到 2 倍 —— 記憶 §11.12），所以「A 比 B 快 41%」在沒有交錯的情況下幾乎沒有資訊。既有紀錄則已經付過那個學費：它通常還附帶了「為什麼」。跳過先驗的代價是一整輪量測，而收益只是把一個已知的答案再確認一次。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
2026-09-18：細粒度臂 `en-fine-nmain16`（`CGC_CB_N_MAIN=1` + `CGC_SERVER_N_CB=16`）在 HEAVY 熱態下量到 13.65 t/s，而控制臂在 NOMINAL 下只有 9.67 t/s（+41%）。差一點就去設計一輪`n_cb` 的 ABBA 掃描。查記憶 `.workbuddy/memory/2026-09-15.md:625`：`n_cb` 1→16 的 `compute` 是 100.99／101.90／104.44／99.14 ms（全 ~100 ms），decode 10.34／9.98／10.28 t/s ⇒ **早已結論「對 decode 無影響」**。再對機制：那個步裡`cb`（編碼）只佔 4.54 ms of 80.07 ms（6%），不可能產生 +41%。⇒ 訊號是噪聲，旋鈕沒有問題。

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/decode_sweep.py`, `.workbuddy/memory/MEMORY_PERF.md`
**看到一個「疑似加速」的單發訊號時，第一步不是設計實驗，是先查既有紀錄有沒有量過那個旋鈕。** 單發、未交錯、且熱態不同的兩個數字，預設是噪聲；若那個旋鈕在本 repo 已被量過，先驗 > 新實驗。而且要用**機制**判斷它是否可能：若該旋鈕控制的東西在步裡只佔個位數百分比，就不可能產生兩位數的加速。

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
§3 of the whitepaper listed a 6-12% deficit of the rebuilt binary against an 18:00 run of an older one, honestly flagged as unquotable for want of an interleaved A/B -- a framing that implicitly assumed the gap needed explaining. Two runs of the IDENTICAL binary 34 minutes apart (22:30 and 23:04, no rebuild in between: libggml-metal and llama-server both timestamped 22:14) produced tg@0 8.67 -> 6.91 (-20.3%), pp@1024 79.88 -> 105.71 (+32.3%), pp@4096 81.52 -> 103.11 (+26.5%) and tg@512 6.72 -> 8.85 (+31.7%), with per-cell ± as large as the effect (pp@512 ±12.65 on 103.25). So the quantity §3 was comparing across builds moves by up to 32% with nothing changed at all, which makes the 6-12% not merely unquotable but unmeasurable by that method. The two runs also disagree on pool behaviour (hit 97.1%/519501 reads vs 97.3%/16163 misses), so it is not only the timing that drifts between launches.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
The same binary, unmodified, two consecutive runs: tg@0 8.67 vs 6.91 t/s.

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/llama_bench_matrix.py`, `docs/PREFILL250_DECODE25_WHITEPAPER_20260915_2240.html`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`, `scripts/check/ab_interleave.py`

Before attributing ANY single-shot throughput difference, measure the repeatability floor of the SAME binary on the same machine: run it twice and take the spread. If the effect you are attributing is smaller than that spread, the comparison has no discriminating power and the correct output is 'not resolvable', not 'direction unknown'. An instrument whose noise exceeds the signal is not a weak instrument, it is a non-instrument.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
-expert-cache 的 BUDGET 是上限：實測 LAYER_CAPS per-layer caps: total 5976 slots、每層 slab=110.00 MiB@256 experts ⇒ 約 2.5 GiB，不是 8192 MiB。把上限當實配會把 13030（model resident，load_mode=none = 匿名頁不可回收）+ 8192 的 21222 MiB 對 16384 MiB（OVERSUBSCRIBED 4838 MiB）算成別的數字。KV 同理：主 context 是 hybrid memory，filter 是 il < n_layer() && !is_recr(il)（llama-model.cpp:2292-2295 -> llama-memory-hybrid.cpp:48-50），full_attention_interval=4 ⇒ 只有 i=3,7,...,39 這 10 層帶 K/V ⇒ 每層每 token 2 kv-head x (256+256) x 2B = 2 KiB ⇒ fp16 @8192 = 160 MiB（q8_0 ≈ 85 MiB）；腳本舊註解的「saves ~0.56GB (1.25GB -> 0.69GB)」對應的是全 41 層 dense attention 的形狀（41 x 1024 x 8192 x 2B = 688 MB），不是這個模型。這一項與槓桿無關（75 MiB vs 超額 4838 MiB），但留一個沒量過的數字在腳本裡當事實會污染後續所有判讀。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
自己踩的單位換算錯：第一版把 10 層算成 164 MiB（20 KiB/token x 8192 = 160 MiB，不是 164），已同時修正 [budget] 的 KV 行與 [kv] 註解。另一個假線索：6144 對照臂的報告顯示 new crash report: llama-server-2026-09-16-113649.ips，那是 11:36 的舊報告——Backup/run_req2_retest.sh 的 newest_ips() 是「取最新檔」而不是「取新檔」，於是把不屬於這次的 .ips 當成自己的。實情由 llama_server_20260916_120538.log 的 4 行自行證明（status 5, kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorOutOfMemory）。

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/run_server.sh`, `Backup/run_req2_retest.sh`, `docs/PREFILL250_THERMAL_TRANSIENT_20260916.html`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`
OOM 要寫成算式而不是形容詞，而且每一項都要標明是「算術」還是「實測」；「池的上限」不等於「實配」。算式印出來之前要複核單位換算。

以下是引擎調校迴圈此刻的狀態。決定**下一個該做什麼**：一個具體的動作，
不要複述狀態。已經被排除的路線不要再走一次。

QUESTION: With the ids proven bit-identical, does repairing the pool/slot content (a) make D3 admissible and (b) deliver the 16.82 t/s that the submit-ahead probe measured -- without the probe's race?

EVIDENCE ON HAND:
- [artifact docs/REMAP_ROUNDTRIP_REMOVAL_PLAN_2026-09-15.md (§9.18.3)] Per (graph, node) pairing against the baseline arm: graphs 0/1/2 are 117/117 bit-identical; graphs 3/4 are 3 SAME / 114 DIFF. The surviving 3 are layer 1's gate/up/down. So the captured ids, and the table lookup that produced them, are proven identical on shared input.
- [artifact docs/REMAP_ROUNDTRIP_REMOVAL_PLAN_2026-09-15.md (§9.18.4)] Layer 1's router ids are identical => its input and router logits are identical; layer 1's MoE ids are identical; yet layer 2's router differs. Same input + same ids + different output => the defect is in the weight content the ids point at, i.e. the pool/slot contents, not in ids and not in the mapping function.
- [artifact docs/REMAP_ROUNDTRIP_REMOVAL_PLAN_2026-09-15.md (§9.17d)] D3's premise is that the graph no longer contains a per-step host write. But the slot_table that slot_lookup reads is still a host-written tensor (publish_slot_table), so the real condition is 'publication is not on the hot path'. Explicitly marked UNTESTED.
- [artifact docs/REMAP_ROUNDTRIP_REMOVAL_PLAN_2026-09-15.md (§1-§2, the D0 probe)] CGC_SUBMIT_AHEAD=1 lifts llama-bench decode 9.16/9.45 -> 16.82 t/s (x1.78), step 82.5 -> 31-44 ms, and ~44% of step time is pipeline-removable. The output is deliberately corrupt; it is a ceiling probe, never a candidate.
- [artifact docs/REMAP_ROUNDTRIP_REMOVAL_PLAN_2026-09-15.md (§9.17b, §9.17g)] Under D3 the probe's number changes meaning: from 'the S2 ceiling' to 'the total value of the segment boundary (= the S3 ceiling)'. And §9.17g already forbids reading the 0.72 vs 16.17 dispatcher comparison as 'D3 will be 20x slower' -- dispatch strategy and split count are different layers.
- [artifact .workbuddy/memory/2026-09-15.md (§D/§L, r4 production)] The r4 production configuration (hot pool + tensorops + MTP + adaptive gate) already runs at ~17 t/s. The submit-ahead probe reached 16.82 t/s with MTP OFF (its baseline is 9.16/9.45). Two different mechanisms land on the same throughput.

ALREADY RULED OUT (do not re-walk these):
- claim: Repairing the pool/slot content means the ~44% becomes available.
  why false: That repair is premise A and it moves nothing in the schedule: S1 keeps n_segs at 40 and the 39 (wait -> CPU -> submit) cycles remain. Correctness and throughput are bought by different changes, and only premise B touches n_segs.
- claim: Today's localization proves the pool contents are the defect.
  why false: It proves the ids and the lookup implementation are innocent, which is narrower. Two sub-suspects with different repairs remain: the table disagreeing with the leaf at consume time (a publication-ordering fix) and the slot contents themselves being wrong (a pool-fill fix). §9.18.6 exists precisely to separate them.
- claim: 16.82 t/s is D3's acceptance threshold.
  why false: It was measured with MTP off on a 9.16/9.45 baseline, while the production configuration with MTP on already runs ~17 t/s. Both are idle-time-filling mechanisms, so the factors are plausibly non-additive and the number has to be re-taken with MTP on.
- claim: D3 removes the race for free, so premise B does not matter for correctness.
  why false: Remove the segment boundary and there is indeed nothing left to interleave, but the slot_table is still host-written. If publication stays per-step the ordering requirement reappears between publish and consume; the race is relocated, not deleted.

Recorded the split into §9.18.7 of the remediation plan (S1 is a probe, not a defect; risk #1 promoted from precondition to mainline). Next measurements, in this order: (1) publish_slot_table call count per decode step -- cheap, host-side, and it decides whether premise B exists at all; (2) capture of ffn_moe_down-1's OUTPUT for both arms on graph 3, to separate 'the table disagrees with the leaf' from 'the slot contents are wrong'; (3) re-measure the submit-ahead ceiling with MTP ON before quoting any D3 acceptance number.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
E4 item 2 的 CLI 層檢查比對拆分前後的 `--help`：第一次跑出 183 bytes 的差異，形狀是舊 entry（在 `/tmp`，沒有快取）噴了一行 `SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\S'` 而新 entry 沒噴。看起來像「CLI 面變了」，實際上新的那棵樹只是命中了我幾分鐘前 import 時留下的 `.pyc`。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
清掉 `scripts/check/knifeedge/__pycache__` 之後，新 entry 一樣噴同一個警告（行號由 `knifeedge_matrix.py:2134` 變成 `knifeedge/host.py:223`，訊息與引文一字不差）⇒ 兩邊的 stdout 逐字元相同（11168 bytes）、stderr 只差在警告裡的檔案路徑。這也讓那條檢查的判準被改成「stdout 逐字元比對 ＋ stderr 比對前先把 warning 區塊換成佔位符」——因為警告內容天生包含路徑與行號，而搬動程式碼必然改變它。

它管轄的檔案：`agent_harness/shared/check_module_split.py`, `scripts/check/knifeedge/host.py`

**編譯期產生的診斷只出現一次** —— `SyntaxWarning` 是在**編譯**原始碼時發出的，載入既有 `.pyc` 時不會重現。所以同一支程式兩次執行的 stderr 不同，可能只是快取狀態不同，而不是行為不同。要比較兩支程式的 stderr（或任何以「有沒有那幾行」為判準的東西），**先把兩邊的 `__pycache__` 都清掉**，否則你比到的是快取。**推論：一個以「新舊輸出逐字元相同」為證據的檢查，必須控制快取。**

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
S1 replaced the host-written remap leaf with get_rows and dropped ggml_set_output(remap). Without it ggml-alloc collapsed 10 of 11 layers' gather outputs onto one address (ids_data=0x128179d60 x10), so every layer read the same 16 ints. Two days of hypotheses about table contents and host visibility were all invalid; adding the one line moved the asserts from 41 to 9 and made ids_data distinct per layer.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
eng-20260915-194332-p25-slotgpu-r1

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-graph.cpp`

When replacing one data flow with an equivalent one, re-inventory every call the ORIGINAL made that looked like mere insurance - those calls are usually the implicit contracts, and they are the ones that get dropped.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
2026-09-17，`CONVENTIONS.md` 第 7 行早就寫著「每一條都必須能指到今天的具體證據（檔名／log 行／欄位值）。指不到的條文不是憲章，是感想」，而 E1 的驗收欄引用了它，卻**從來沒有被執行過**。寫 `agent_harness/shared/check_citations.py` 時，第一版在**乾淨的**憲章上報 **84 個問題，全部是假的**，分六類：①只在 repo 根解析（80 個假懸空；`validate.py` 其實在 `engine_loop/traces/`）②行文斜線被當路徑（`gpu_union/wait`、`peak/mean`、`IQR/中位數`）③decision id 用精確比對（id 是 `dec-YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<slug>`，憲章只引到 `dec-…-HHMM`，要**前綴**比對）④副檔名本身（`.m`／`.sh`——行文在講「獨漏 .m」）⑤承前省略（`..._202725.log`）⑥**同一格程式碼裡路徑後面跟著參數**（`prefill_gputime_report.py --decprof-pair …`）。第 ⑥ 類最貴：它讓 A18 被報成「完全沒有指針」，於是人會去補一條本來就合格的條文。修完六類後：懸空 0，61/61 條都有交代（59 可解析指針 ＋ 2 顯式標記）。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
陽性對照：把 `agent_harness/fake/nope.jsonl` 注入憲章副本的 A1 → 懸空必須由 0 變 1（實測 0→1）；沒有這一格，「0 懸空」與「檢查器根本沒在跑」是同一個輸出。第二個反例是**判準的位移**：`- 證據形態：…` 這個標記之所以必要，是因為憲章自己的括號裡就寫了「欄位值」——B25 的證據是一次 `grep` 的輸出，本來就沒有檔案可指；把它算成不合格，就是把驗收條件從「有交代」偷偷換成「有檔案」。

它管轄的檔案：`agent_harness/shared/check_citations.py`, `agent_harness/shared/README.md`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`, `agent_harness/engine_loop/traces/validate.py`
把一條早就寫在文件裡、卻從未被執行的驗收變成檢查時，成本**通常在量具不在規則**：一個「每一條都要有 X」的掃描器，它的**假陽性率**才是設計內容。所以這種檢查的第一個交付物不是它抓到什麼，而是**它自己的假陽性清單**；第二個是**陽性對照**（注入一個該抓的，證明它會抓）。反過來：一個在乾淨輸入上也報一堆問題的掃描器，它產生的不是待辦清單而是噪音——而噪音會讓人去『修』沒壞的東西。

Both the llama-server binaries and the library dylibs live under the tracked build tree, and two sessions were driving the same GPU in the same half hour. The pre-flight `lsof -iTCP:8080` was written into the same shell line as the `cmake --build`, printed the other session's listening server, and the build ran anyway -- replacing libggml-metal and libllama underneath a run that had started 54 seconds earlier. 它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
2026-09-17 11:29:13 (this machine): `lsof -nP -iTCP:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN` printed `llama-ser 25649 ... TCP *:8080 (LISTEN)` and `pgrep -fl llama-server` printed the same process, in the same command whose next statement relinked `libggml-metal.0.19.0.dylib` and `libllama.0.0.279.dylib`. The other line's runner had started at 11:28:19 and its next arm began at 11:29:22 on the new library. 它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/build/bin/libggml-metal.0.19.0.dylib`, `src/llama.cpp/build/bin/libllama.0.0.279.dylib`, `scripts/check/decode_sweep.py`

A tracked build artifact is a SHARED resource: rebuilding writes to every experiment currently running on that machine, not just to your own tree. A pre-flight check that merely PRINTS the conflict is not a gate -- the check and the act must be in one branch, so that a non-empty result aborts instead of being observed and then ignored. Before any build, gate on BOTH (a) a listener on the harness port and (b) the measurement processes of every other line (the runner script and the sweep), and abort if either is present; and treat 'the binaries are tracked' as the reason this matters -- a build is a commit-shaped act on the machine's shared state even when nothing is written to git.

QUESTION: Does capturing ffn_moe_down on both arms settle §9.18 -- if the arms share the layer-1 MoE input, share the ids (proved by the kernel capture) and share the lookup, does a differing output prove the carrier is the WEIGHT CONTENT the ids point at?

EVIDENCE ON HAND:
- [artifact Backup/phase_decomp/s1_outcap3_20260915.json] Decode capture, 12 decode graphs x 40 layers = 480 (graph, layer) pairs per arm. base vs slotgpu: 480/480 differ (100%), including il=0 at graph=0 -- the very first MoE layer of the very first decode step. Shapes agree exactly (ne=[2048, 8, 1] everywhere), so this is values, not geometry.
- [artifact Backup/phase_decomp/s1_outcap3b_20260915.json] The same arm run twice in two separate processes: 0/480 differ. So the probe is deterministic and the pin introduces no run-to-run noise -- the 480/480 is a property of the arms, not of the instrument. It also means the cross-arm difference is not attributable to the pin's allocator perturbation behaving differently per run.
- [artifact Backup/cgc_logs/llama_server_20260915_233238.log] Row split (OUTSET): for all 480 pairs, the SORTED multiset of per-expert-row hashes also differs. So the arms are NOT permutations of each other's expert rows -- the per-expert VALUES differ. That removes the one cheap explanation (a reordered top-k vector, which is invisible in the weighted sum and would have left the row multiset intact).
- [artifact Backup/phase_decomp/s1_outpre_20260915.json] The prefill ladder, layers 0-3, is structured rather than uniform: on the graphs served by the prefill-stream slab (ntok=182 the real prompt, ntok=22 the assistant prefix, all 256 experts resident) ALL FOUR LAYERS are bit-identical; on the graphs served by the partial pool (ntok=2 warmup x2, ntok=4 x2, 143 of 256 resident) layer 0 is identical and layers 1-3 are not. Layer 0 is the unpooled layer, so the first diverging layer is the first POOLED one.

ALREADY RULED OUT (do not re-walk these):
- claim: The differing MoE output proves the ids resolve to different WEIGHT CONTENT (a pool-fill defect).
  why false: The premise that the two arms share the layer-1 MoE input is false: layer 0 differs at decode graph 0, and layer 0's input is state inherited from the prefill, not computed in that graph. A differing output downstream of an already-differing input says nothing about which of the possible carriers produced it.
- claim: The arms differ by a permutation of the top-k experts, so only the summation order is affected.
  why false: The OUTSET row split compares the sorted multiset of per-expert-row hashes: it differs in all 480 (graph, layer) pairs. A permutation would leave the multiset intact.
- claim: The 480/480 result is an artefact of ggml_set_output perturbing the allocator, since pinning is numerically relevant in this codebase.
  why false: Determinism check, not argument: the same arm answers 0/480 across two separate processes, so the pin's perturbation is reproducible and identical run to run, and a pin applied to both arms cannot by itself produce a difference that is absent when the same arm is repeated. The perturbation affects the level of the numbers, not their equality.

The decode capture is closed as a probe: it answers 'where does the mechanism differ' (the pool path) and cannot answer 'which carrier'. The next measurement is scoped to the pool path and to slot CONTENT rather than to the mapping, since the mapping is separately excluded (see dec-2346). The prefill window stays at 0-3 and is NOT widened by raising the layer count: pinning 11 layers on prefill graphs dies at the warmup decode with the same Metal OOM as pinning 40 on every graph, while 4 layers and 40-on-decode both run, so the binding constraint is pins per graph and the safe number lies between 4 and 11.

The slot->expert annotation was added to the pool-row capture and documented as `own=[...]`, with `own=none` reserved for 'not annotated'. The dumper printed a bare comma list. The comparator, written against the documentation, therefore found no owner on any row and printed its loud 'OWNER CHANNEL ABSENT -- no CONTENT rows must not be read as the content axis was cleared' warning, on two runs whose ggml-metal banner said `owner channel ACTIVE` in the same log. The first reading of a brand-new instrument was a false alarm about the instrument itself, and the run had to be repeated after a rebuild.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Run 2026-09-17 11:0x: the comparator printed OWNER CHANNEL ABSENT for /tmp/r13_own1.log, whose line 38 reads `CGC-POOL-CAP: owner channel ACTIVE (CGC-IDS-CAP rows will carry own=[...])`. After printing brackets, the same logs give `owner column: 210 of 210 POOL rows carry own=`. The comparator now also accepts the bare form, and a truncated `own=[5,9` (no closing bracket) is deliberately still treated as NOT annotated rather than as a short list.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.cpp`, `Backup/compare_pool_row.py`

A printed field's delimiter is part of its contract, not cosmetic: if a reader is documented to recognise `key=[...]`, the writer must print the brackets, and a liberal reader that accepts the bare form as well is a compatibility convenience rather than a licence to print either. The failure mode is specific and nasty -- the reader reports 'field absent', which is indistinguishable from 'the producer was never enabled', while the producer's own banner a few lines earlier says it is ACTIVE. Whenever a tool can report 'the instrument is missing', that report must be distinguishable from 'the instrument ran and I could not read it', or every absence verdict becomes unfalsifiable.

A path returned by a directory-resolving tool is expressed relative to THAT tool's working directory, not yours. Anchor every cross-directory path to your own base before using it. A relative return that is perfectly correct inside the tool's own cwd silently mis-targets everywhere else -- and the failure can be a total no-op that still prints success.

觀測（because）：
Capability and request are two different facts, and both failure modes look like silence: a truncated filter and an op that was never hooked are indistinguishable unless the instrument prints the EFFECTIVE list it accepted and the consumer prints the names it was asked for but never captured. Fix is two-sided by construction: raise the buffer and warn on truncation at init, print the effective list at startup, and have the analyser emit a 'requested but never captured' block with the three possible causes (filter truncated / name belongs to a VIEW with no kernel / op not hooked).

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
The round was internally consistent and looked like a clean negative result: every node reported `never`, and the same-arm control agreed. It was committed as evidence before the 256-byte buffer was found; the truncation point sat inside `attn_residu`. After raising the buffer to 2048 the same request produced the missing nodes and the verdict changed.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.cpp`, `Backup/analyze_capture_nodes.py`

A name filter with a fixed-size buffer silently drops its own tail, and the drop is invisible from both ends. `CGC_TENSOR_CAPTURE` is copied into a fixed `dst_filter[N]`, so a long comma-separated list is cut MID-NAME: a 23-name request (312 chars) fitted only 19 names against a 256-byte buffer, truncating inside the 20th, and the four lost names included the one node that round existed to read. The second half of the defect is on the consumer side: the analyser listed only the names that appeared, so a name that was dropped by the filter printed as 'nobody asked for this' -- the same shape as a name the producing op never emitted.

All three readers of that variable test presence -- llama.cpp:396, llama-expert-cache.cpp:1708, llama-context.cpp:5222 -- so "0" is non-null, the gate is TRUE, and blk.0 has been excluded from the pool the entire time: llama-model-loader.cpp:1464 forces l4_kind = -1 for layer 0 and its FFN reads the full-width tensor with raw ids. The consequence is that a documented quality fix has been inert for six days, and -- separately -- that the resolved-config sidecars (gate caps, llama-bench json) all record `LLAMA_EXPERT_CACHE_L4_SKIP_LAYER0: "0"`, i.e. they record an INTENT while the engine implements its opposite. LLAMA_EXPERT_CACHE_L4_SKIP_LAYER0's three readers were switched from a presence test to value semantics on 2026-09-16. Without the control arm the 4/9 would have been indistinguishable from 'the fix broke something'. This is the opposite failure mode to the CGC_OA_ASYNC round (dec-20260915-2215), where the resolved string itself moved (CGC_OA_ASYNC 0 -> 1) and the gate raised INVALID COMPARISON on its own, waking someone up. Value-semantics changes get no such alarm, so the re-baseline has to be a declared act rather than a detected one.

Two runs with byte-identical resolved env strings (LLAMA_EXPERT_CACHE_L4_SKIP_LAYER0=0 in both) that are nonetheless not comparable: one dumped 39 pooled layers, the other 40. A fix that changes what a config value MEANS while leaving the string unchanged is invisible to a resolved-config comparability check, because that check is a string diff. It will report a plain FAIL that is a category error, not a regression. So: (a) re-baseline deliberately and retire the old reference, and (b) run the PRE-fix value as a control arm first -- it must reproduce the old reference bit-identically, which is simultaneously the proof that the old reference was dumped under the old behaviour and that the predicate change is numerically inert in every other dimension.

觀測（because）：
The S1 divergence had been chased through the layer axis: the decode capture reported 480/480 layers differing, including layer 0, so the natural next move was to walk deeper layer windows to find the first bad layer. That ladder was uninterpretable from the start -- decode step 0's layer-0 input descends from the prefill's KV and the two arms' prefills already disagree (M1 5/9), so every decode layer is downstream of an earlier divergence, and there is no 'identical input' origin at which a first divergence can be defined. Re-running it where the input IS identical by construction (prefill, layer 0 = embedding) produced the answer: probing layers 0-3 and then layers 4-7 (disjoint, 8 layers, 6 graphs, 2 arms = 96 pairings) returned the SAME structure both times. Crucially the two rungs did not agree on which layer first diverges -- they agreed that divergence tracks a property of the GRAPH, not of the layer: slab-served graphs (256/256 experts resident) were bit-identical across all 8 probed layers, pool-served graphs (143/256) diverged from the first pooled layer on. The predictor was verified against an independent runtime marker, `CGC-PREFILL-STREAM: il=0 kind=0 ntok=182`, which appears on exactly the two all-EQ graphs. The cost of the misdirection was real: the first capture attempt pinned all 40 layers in every graph and killed the process at load (see eng-mh-0012), and two layer windows were measured before the orthogonal property was noticed.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
A layer ladder measured twice, 0-3 and 4-7, whose two windows agreed on the divergence structure rather than on a first-divergent index -- the signature that the layer index was never the variable, while the analysis was still framed as 'find the first bad layer'.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.cpp`, `scripts/check/decode_sweep.py`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`

If a difference reproduces with the SAME structure at two DISJOINT slices of the axis you suspected, that axis is not the variable -- stop deepening it and look for a property of the container instead. Two windows that agree on 'which items differ' rather than 'the first item that differs' have already answered the question.

**寫在 docstring 裡的「未驗證」是一張欠條，而它的面額通常遠小於你以為的。** `build_prompt()` 的 docstring 掛著「★ NOT YET VERIFIED AGAINST A REAL MODEL … `15+27` 必須答 `42`」已經一天，理由一直是「唯一那顆 GPU 被另一條線的量測佔著」—— 而**關掉它的成本是兩次短呼叫、約 20 秒**（一次正向、一次陰性），不是那一輪 15 小時的大跑。判準：把每一條「未驗證」的宣稱當成一張欠條，問「**最少**要多少才能關掉它」；若答案是「一次短請求」，就先做，不要把它綁在大跑上（大跑的窗難等，短請求的窗到處都是）。★ 第二半同樣要緊：**正向不算證據，除非配上陰性對照**。這次的陰性（同一個 prompt，只把生成段縮成裸的 `<|im_start|>assistant\n`）重現了那個 scaffold 存在的理由 —— 進入 thinking 模式、把 token 額度用完而不作答；沒有它，「42」只說明問題太簡單。

**對比工具必須容忍「有一側早停」——否則它會偏偏在「該說這臂無效」的那一刻崩掉。** 一個會產生 `invalid` 結果的守護（死伺服器防護、timeout、中斷）之後，產物是**部分**的：profile 數少於完整跑。若對比函式逐「A 的 key 集合」去索引 B，第一個缺失的 key 就 `KeyError` ⇒ 使用者拿到 traceback 而不是「這份無效」。正確形狀：走**兩側的聯集**、缺的一側印 `n/a`、**把 `invalid` 在表頭大聲標出來並且不讓它的通過數被當成分數**、總計列在題數不同時**拒絕相減**。判準是：*任何會標記「此結果無效」的路徑，都必須有對應的「以無效身分被讀取」的路徑。*

觀測（because）：
eng-diag-0017 established the weaker half of this (constructing a tensor is not putting it in the graph -- only ggml_build_forward_expand does). CGC_S1_BUILD_LEAF=1 exercised the other half and found that being in the graph is also not enough. The arm builds the host remap leaf and deliberately leaves it unconsumed, which is exactly what the header comment on cache_slot_table_tensors has always claimed S1 does ('the leaf itself is still built when this is on: it is simply not consumed ... a pure scheduler/dispatch change'). With `slots` neither consumed nor expanded, the GET_ROWS/CONT/VIEW chain drops out of the graph, `slot_table` is left alive only by the unconditional `ggml_build_forward_expand(gf, slot_table)` above it, and the new `remap` leaf is expanded too -- so the graph ends up with two roots that nothing reads. The server aborted in llama_context::graph_reserve, i.e. during context construction, having generated nothing. The practical form: 'build the node' is a sentence about the builder's intent; 'the node exists' requires a consumer, and a design that only satisfies the first cannot be measured at all -- so it must not be planned as the control for a hypothesis.

觀測（because）：
A GGUF header parser reproduced the loader's pool-capacity formula as `per_slot = MAX over all layers`. The loader computes that MAX over TRUNK layers only (it skips the NextN/MTP layer explicitly, so the trunk's pool cannot depend on how the head happens to be stored) while still counting every layer in the denominator. On the shipped model the two agree, because its MTP layer is THINNER than the trunk's binding layer -- so the tool matched the engine on every check that had been run (107/143/179 verified against two engine runs). The moment a second model was tried whose MTP layer is q8_0 and thus thicker, the tool reported 15 slots where the engine computes 148. Nothing about the first model's numbers looked wrong, and the tool had already been quoted in a plan document.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
2026-09-17: `scripts/check/gguf_pool_geometry.py` vs the engine on `Ornith-1.5-35B-...gguf`. Uncorrected formula: per_slot = blk.40 (q8_0) = 3,342,336 B -> clamp(2 GiB/(41*3,342,336),8,256) = 15. Engine, same 2 GiB budget: `n_slots=29` with `LAYER_CAPS per-layer caps: total 1416 slots (avg 34.5/layer, min 29/layer)`. Corrected (MAX over trunk only): per_slot = blk.0 = 1,769,472 B -> 29, and the census prediction matches the engine's line exactly at both 2 GiB (1416) and 4 GiB (2616, engine `n_slots=59`).

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/gguf_pool_geometry.py`

When a tool reimplements an engine's formula, validate it on at least two artifacts that differ in exactly the dimension the formula's conditionals touch -- and make the tool print which branch it took. A formula that is only ever checked against one artifact encodes that artifact's accident as if it were the rule. Concretely: any reimplementation must read the SAME discriminators the engine reads (here, the GGUF's own nextn count), not infer them from the artifact in hand, because the artifact in hand may happen to make the branch irrelevant.

    build=same-as-above  quotable=False
- [artifact src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-backend.cpp] Line 1745 gated the segmented dispatch on `getenv("CGC_OA_ASYNC") != nullptr && getenv("CGC_VERIFY_OP_TIMING") == nullptr && strcmp(ggml_backend_name(split_backend), "CPU") != 0`. A != nullptr test selects on PRESENCE, not value, so CGC_OA_ASYNC=0 -- and an empty string, since getenv returns "" and not NULL -- took the segmented branch. scripts/run_server.sh sets CGC_OA_ASYNC unconditionally from SERVER_OA_ASYNC, so there was no way to unset it through the runner either.

ALREADY RULED OUT (do not re-walk these):
- claim: CGC_SERVER_OA_ASYNC=0 selects the non-segmented dispatcher, so the earlier noasync pair isolates the ordering effect.
  why false: ggml-backend.cpp:1745 tested getenv("CGC_OA_ASYNC") != nullptr. The value is never read, so 0 selected the segmented branch exactly as 1 does, and the two arms reproduced the segmented arms' md5 sets and pool counters verbatim.

它管轄的檔案：`Backup/compare_pool_row.py`

The number of rows a comparator may compare is bounded by the OPERAND's size on both sides, not by the depth the capture was ASKED for. A capture that digests 'the first N ids the consumer used' writes fewer rows than N whenever the operand holds fewer ids, and the unwritten rows are pure sentinel -- so a comparison that iterates to N manufactures a 'measurement gap' verdict for a region that never existed. Distinguish three things that all look like a short reading: rows BEYOND the operand (exclude; not part of the question), rows the operand has but the reader did not cover (report as a gap, with the covered prefix named), and rows covered but never written (a genuine instrumentation failure). Record the operand's size in the row so the reader can tell them apart -- a capture depth that is a knob cannot double as the operand's size.

觀測（because）：
The CGC_S1_KEEP_LEAF control repoints mul_mat_id from the GPU gather (slots) to the host leaf. That silently turned CONT, GET_ROWS and the VIEW into orphans AND left slot_table -- still a graph root, still ggml_set_output -- with no consumer, so the scheduler never assigned it a backend and the process died at model load with ggml-alloc.c:623 GGML_ASSERT(buffer_id >= 0), stack ggml_gallocr_allocate_node <- ggml_gallocr_reserve_n_impl <- ggml_backend_sched_reserve <- llama_context::graph_reserve (llama_server_20260915_211705.log). Constructing a tensor does not put it in the graph; only ggml_build_forward_expand does. The fix is one line -- keep the chain live by expanding slots as well -- and it is the same lesson this investigation keeps meeting from a new side (set_output missing -> aliasing; index vector read late -> dead buffer; slot_table unconsumed -> unassigned backend): the graph is a traversal, and every assumption about who computes or holds a buffer has to be checked against that traversal, not against the source that created the tensor.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-graph.cpp`, `src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-alloc.c`

A node is present only when the graph traversal AND the allocator can both see it: repointing a consumer at a different tensor orphans everything upstream of the old one, and ggml-alloc aborts the reserve build on a root that nothing consumes.

觀測（because）：
`grep -c 'sampler|speculat|draft|MTP' tools/llama-bench/llama-bench.cpp` is 0. `test_gen` is `llama_decode(1 token); llama_synchronize(ctx); token = rand()%n_vocab;` (llama-bench.cpp:2168-2183) -- no sampler, no draft, no verify, no accept. Every remaining lever for the 25 t/s decode target is MTP, and MTP needs a sampler to decide acceptance, so llama-bench can only ever report the MTP *model* running without speculation (measured: 8.75 +- 0.95, i.e. no benefit visible). The random stream is not a cosmetic detail either: it changes what the expert pool is asked to do -- random ids gave 96.0% hit with 85.4% COMPULSORY misses and only 7 of 40 layers over-subscribed, where the same engine serving coherent text gave 92.6% with 51.0% compulsory / 49.0% capacity and ALL 40 layers over-subscribed, reading 3.35x the bytes (18.35 GiB vs 5.48 GiB). A stream whose expert union is unpredictable is also the stream a prefetcher cannot help, which is a plausible reason llama-bench's higher hit rate coexists with its lower t/s.

觀測（because）：
CGC_SLOT_TABLE_GPU builds the GPU table INSTEAD of the host remap leaf -- llama-graph.cpp:2178-2242 is an if/else, so for il >= CGC_S1_MIN_IL the leaf is never created and cache_remap_tensors[il] stays empty. The ONE increment of cache->n_zero_mapped_selected (llama-context.cpp:5475) sits inside the leaf-write block, which the hook skips when remap == nullptr. Every served layer therefore stops reporting the 'a selected expert read the ZERO slot' quality leak, and the teardown line (llama-expert-cache.cpp:2229) prints n_zero_mapped_selected=0 -- byte-identical to a run with no leak. The S1 A/B is documented as a pure scheduler/dispatch change; this monitoring change it carries silently is not in that description, and a gate that reads that counter would pass for the wrong reason. Note the code comment at llama-context.h:364 claims the opposite ('the leaf itself is still built when this is on'), which is how the trap survived review.

觀測（because）：
CGC_S1_OUT_CAP pins ffn_moe_down with ggml_set_output so a post-synchronize read sees a live buffer. The first version pinned every layer in every graph and both arms died at the load-time warmup decode with kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorOutOfMemory -> CGC_METAL_FAIL_STOP abort (2/2), while the control arm without the knob started and decoded at 20.2 t/s in the same session. The obvious explanation -- bytes -- was written into the code comment as '2048 x 6144 x 4B = 50 MB per layer, ~2 GB for 40 layers' and it is WRONG in the direction that matters. Corrected, the boundary is: 40 layers on every graph dies; 11 layers on prefill only ALSO dies; 4 layers on prefill runs; 40 layers on decode runs. At the graph that dies the hook reports ntok=2, so ffn_moe_down is [2048, 8, 2] F32 and eleven pinned layers hold 11 x 131 KB = 1.4 MB. A megabyte and a half does not exhaust a Metal working set, so the controlling variable is the COUNT of tensors marked as graph outputs -- which changes the scheduler's allocation and split -- and it is non-monotone in the phase (prefill chunks are excluded, yet prefill-only pinning is the variant that dies). Two consequences worth keeping: the safe number is empirical (between 4 and 11 here), and a byte budget would have been wrong twice, once as 2 GB and once as 5 MB.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Eleven pinned tensors totalling 1.4 MB abort a 16 GB machine's Metal command buffer, while forty pinned tensors on the same tensors abort too -- and forty pinned tensors on a different phase do not.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.cpp`, `src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.h`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`

A probe that must perturb the allocator to read its value has a cost measured in PINS PER GRAPH, not in bytes, and that cost can only be found by experiment. Do not derive the safe budget from tensor dimensions, and do not creep up on the limit: the failure mode is a fail-stop abort at load, not a slowdown.

**以「綁定名」為鍵建立 import 表，會讓綁定同名的那第二個 import 靜默覆蓋第一個。** `import urllib.error` 與 `import urllib.request` 綁定的是**同一個**名字 `urllib`，所以 `{綁定名: import 敘述}` 形式的字典只留得下最後一個；之後任何「這個模組用到 urllib ⇒ 就 import 那一條」的重建都會漏掉另一條。危險的地方是它**仍然會跑** —— 因為 `urllib.request` 自己會 `import urllib.error`，`urllib.error.HTTPError` 照樣解析得到。**僥倖不是保證。** 正確的做法是讓值成為**列表**（綁定名 → 所有相關 import 敘述），並讓「重建出來的樹是否含有原檔每一個 import」變成檢查項。

A durable record's effective capacity is set by its weakest consumer, not by the disk, and exceeding it fails silently by losing the TAIL. A canonical file that is read whole by an injection step with a fixed limit therefore degrades from the back end, where the most recently added (and often most actionable) material lives -- and the file keeps reporting its true size, so nothing looks broken. Split the record by topic into an index plus topic files, and before splitting verify that every consumer of it enumerates rather than whitelists, or the new files will be silently missed -- which is the same defect in the other direction.

條件式交付的合法性取決於**條件可不可量測**，而不是取決於它聽起來多合理。如果條件不可由可用的儀器觀測（例如需要 root 才能讀的 DVFS 檔位），那麼閘門只能**分類這一輪的宣稱**（COLD／HOT／UNKNOWN），**不能**印出「已滿足前提」——後者是宣稱讀到了一個它讀不到的東西，也就是假證據。同時：候選變數在時間上與真因耦合時（例：swap 在同一個安靜期間與熱一起復原），排除它要靠**順序相反**的配對，不是靠相關。

Its recorded verdict '14 MODEL-ZERO / 0 ENGINE-ZERO' was structurally guaranteed, not measured. Reading the WHOLE row stride (335872 B for blk.*.ffn_{gate,up}_exps, confirmed equal to the engine's nb02 in the log) shows the file truth: 10 of 31488 gate/up/down rows have a zero leading run of 4592-13120 B (a whole number of 656-B quantised row lines) while being 17.8-47.0% non-zero overall -- layer 0 experts 25/195/205/252 and layer 1 expert 214, gate+up in each case -- and every one of the other 31478 rows has a leading zero run of exactly 0. So the pool region being zero there is REQUIRED by the checkpoint, and both alarms were false positives of the same shared blind spot.

A memory-pressure counter is not a measurement of the resource the engine depends on. `Pages free` moves with page-cache size (large cache -> low free -> FAST) and with other-process footprint (large anon -> low free -> SLOW) in opposite directions, and reporting their sum averages the two into a number that predicts nothing.

觀測（because）：
The pool-row A/B run at 11:28 on this machine had its binaries replaced underneath it: two libraries were relinked 3 seconds apart (libggml-metal at 11:29:13, libllama at 11:29:16), and the first arm's fingerprint was computed inside that 3-second window. It therefore recorded the NEW libggml-metal hash together with the OLD libllama hash -- a build that never existed as a running configuration -- while the second arm recorded the new pair. Read naively, the two arms 'share' the metal key and differ on llama, which invites the conclusion that only one library changed; in fact the whole run straddled two builds and neither arm is quotable.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
Run 2026-09-17 11:28 (Backup/phase_decomp/ids_dst_capture_20260917_112819.json): arm p25-gputime-churn -> {libggml-metal: 7ac0ac2cdedd, libllama: 1010579c5b33}; arm p25-slotgpu-churn -> {libggml-metal: 7ac0ac2cdedd, libllama: 24ca3917d5cf}. The on-disk pair at the time of reading is {7ac0ac2cdedd, 24ca3917d5cf} and 1010579c5b33 exists nowhere on disk, so the first arm's dict is a mixture. The rerun at 11:31 gives {7ac0ac2cdedd, 24ca3917d5cf} for both arms, matching the disk.

它管轄的檔案：`scripts/check/decode_sweep.py`

A build fingerprint assembled by reading several files one at a time is not atomic: if a relink is in progress, it can stamp a combination of versions that never ran together, and it does so silently -- the dict looks complete and every key is a real hash. Take the fingerprint TWICE (at launch and at teardown) and mark the row not-comparable when they differ, or else detect that any of the files changed while the fingerprint was being assembled and refuse it. The reason this matters more than a normal race: the fingerprint is the thing that decides which rows may be compared, so a torn one does not produce a wrong number, it produces a wrong permission -- it licenses a comparison that must not happen.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
llama_expert_cache_publish_slot_table returns the number of entries it had to clamp to 0 because the layer has no reserved ZERO slot, and §8.3 identified that count as the signal of a SILENT correctness failure: with zero_slot < 0 a non-resident selected expert makes the host leaf write -1 (loud -- the consumer reports an out-of-range id) while the table clamps it to 0 (index 0 is legal, so mul_mat_id reads a DIFFERENT expert's weights). There are exactly two call sites. The fast-path site checked the return value and printed it. The pool-path site discarded it outright -- and the pool path is the one EVERY MTP-off S1 arm actually takes, because CGC_SERVER_MTP=0 makes verify_fast and draft_fast both false so the `(verify_fast || draft_fast) && cgc_fast_eligible` guard is never entered. Every S1 measurement to date therefore computed the silent-corruption counter and threw it away. A second, independent divergence sat in the same pair: the two sites write the LEAF under different mappings (slot_table_safe vs the raw slot table) while publishing the TABLE through the same function, so their table/leaf equivalence is asserted, not shared.

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
A counter that is computed on every publish of the arm being measured, and read by nobody on that path.

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/src/llama-context.cpp`, `src/llama.cpp/src/llama-expert-cache.h`, `src/llama.cpp/src/llama-expert-cache.cpp`, `agent_harness/CONVENTIONS.md`

A gate quantity computed at one call site and DISCARDED at another is not a gate quantity. Enforce it by funnelling every site through one counted entry point, not by adding a counter and hoping each caller reads it -- the caller that does not read it is exactly the caller the gate exists for.

以下是一條引擎調校迴圈裡「付過代價」的觀測。請把它一般化成**一條可重用的規訓**——
換一個問題也適用，而且讀者手上沒有這筆 episode 也必須能照著做。

觀測（because）：
解決器沒有錯，錯的是模型。重疊的觀測窗（同一段時間裡多個 command buffer 並行）**本來就不可加**，所以「每個節點一個固定成本」這種線性分解是不可辨識的，而秩虧會讓無限多組解並列 —— 其中一些帶負號。這種錯誤的形狀特別危險：它會**印出一張看起來很完整的表**（每個種類都有 ns/node 與百分比），而沒有任何欄位顯示它是垃圾。

它實際被違反的紀錄（counterexample_observed）：
2026-09-18 flashkv-devserver 的節點級 GPU 時間：一個 segment 的 9 個 Metal command buffer 在時間上重疊（`union < busy_sum`），而每個 buffer 覆蓋一段連續節點。用 `dur_i = Σ_k cnt_ik · t_k` 離線最小平方想還原「每種類每節點的成本」：**`rank = 15 of 22`**、**rms 殘差 0.457 ms ＝ 平均 buffer 時長的 60.7%**、係數出現**負值**（`ffn_moe_logits` −2 580 697 ns/node、`attn_norm` −1 733 862）⇒ 模型不合、解不唯一。**而陽性對照卻回報 max relative error 0.010「OK」** —— 因為它用同一個 `A` 合成（`b = A·t_true`）。改用區間就不再需要那個模型：對每個種類報「**只含該種類的 buffer 時長之和**（下界）」與「**含該種類的所有 buffer 時長之和**（上界）」。實測 `ffn_moe_gate` 的 cntw 只有 1.91 ms 而上界 122.37 ms（segment busy 271.94 ms）⇒ 點估計錯了 64 倍，而區間立刻把真值框到 [0, 45%]。

它管轄的檔案：`src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-backend.cpp`, `docs/GPU_NODE_ATTRIBUTION_20260918_0126.html`

**當一個「每單位成本」無法從手上的觀測辨識時，報**區間**，不要報點估計 —— 也不要換一個求解器。** 判別式有兩步：(1) 看係數矩陣的**秩**，秩 < 欄數就是「有多組解都一樣好」；(2) 用**合成資料**做陽性對照時要警覺 —— 若合成資料是由那個**同一個**設計矩陣生出來的（`b = A·t_true`），它就落在 `A` 的像空間裡，最小平方一定還原得回來，**即使 `A` 秩虧**。所以陽性對照通過**不能**證明這條路可行；要看的是**真實資料的殘差**與係數是否落在物理範圍。
